units: Diagram positions are unitless; cohort numbers are design counts, not model performance.
caption: Study workflow and information settings. (a) Retrospective monitoring uses dated untreated BASF/Corteva assessments and qualified station/reanalysis weather. Historical fitting precedes the evaluated season; query context admits strictly earlier own-field disease and weather through the preceding day. Query-day, later and other-field disease is withheld. Five temporal and 15 spatial folds retain 2,017 forecasts per design, 192 field-seasons and 121 sites. Inherited crop-feature ancestry remains qualified. (b) Autonomous simulations use daily mean/maximum temperature, humidity and precipitation, imposed sowing and coordinates. Host development determines tissue availability and exposure windows; disease does not feed back on development. The normalized symptom-tissue integral is not measured physiological loss. The dashed branch is a retrospective flag-leaf replay: 45 calibration and 70 original-2019 evaluation records, without new fitting or independent physiological validation. Monitoring skill is not transferred to climate projections. Icons are conceptual; solid arrows show dependencies and the dashed arrow marks retrospective checking.
